metadata.description: This week on the Tribal Bulletin, we cover the critical return of AFSPA in parts of Manipur and its implications for tribal communities. From Jharkhand, get the latest election updates focusing on tribal participation. Celebrate Janjatiya Gaurav Diwas as we highlight events honouring the rich heritage and contributions of India’s tribal communities. Lastly, we delve into the ongoing debate on SC-ST reservation in the private sector and its potential impact on social equity. Stay tuned for comprehensive coverage of issues shaping the lives of tribals across India.
